name: pr-proof
description: Proof that a pull request's change works: prepare-proof judges which proof a branch needs, with signals from TypeSafe Jev or Gemini Decision when a key is set, then produces each kind, a narrated walkthrough video with playwright-recast, screenshots at the project's breakpoints, and masked terminal or API transcripts, and hands it to pr-open through the branch's proof manifest.

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: Key for the TypeSafe API. Leave empty to read TYPESAFE_API_KEY.

typesafe_endpoint.title: TypeSafe endpoint
typesafe_endpoint.description: Base URL of the TypeSafe API

typesafe_model.title: Jev model
typesafe_model.description: Model name or alias, such as jev-latest or jev-1.14.0

gemini_api_key.title: Gemini API key
gemini_api_key.description: Gemini Developer API key for Gemini Decision. Leave empty to read GEMINI_DECISIONS_API_KEY, then GEMINI_API_KEY.

decision_backend.title: Decision backend
decision_backend.description: Which model answers the proof signals: auto uses the one key that is set and asks when both are; both runs TypeSafe and Gemini side by side and logs the pair for comparison.

primary_backend.title: Primary backend
primary_backend.description: With both backends, the one whose answer is used for the proof signals; the other is shown beside it.

screenshot_widths.title: Screenshot widths
screenshot_widths.description: Comma-separated viewport widths in pixels, such as 375,768,1440. Leave empty to use the project's breakpoints, or 375, 768 and 1440.
